metadata.title: The Short Seller Who Called Out Nvidia Has a New Target<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
The Short Seller Who Called Out Nvidia Has a New Target
Back in May, Christian Lamarco, the 31-year-old who runs short-selling firm Culper Research, put out a prescient report: “NVIDIA (NVDA): The China Problem.” It alleged that a substantial amount of Nvidia’s chip sales were illegally going to China and that Jensen Huang had an “uncomfortably close relationship with Megaspeed’s Alice Huang.”
